beatLines.line: 🍽️ Thin day. Your bowl stays half-full — the other half goes to Kenneth, who's been quiet about being hungry.
🍽️ You push half your bowl across the fire to Willie — 'eat. You need it more than I do.' Willie doesn't argue. The bowl comes back scraped clean.
🍽️ The bins are thin, and Megan looks it. You set your second half in front of Megan. 'Eat,' you say. Megan eats like someone making up for days.
🍽️ Half your share tonight. You hand the rest to Willie, who takes it with both hands and doesn't say a word until it's gone.
🍽️ You wave off the second scoop and nod toward Xavier. 'Xavier eats first tonight.' Nobody at the fire disagrees.
